authority: Konami official Yu-Gi-Oh! OCG Card Database

cards.name: The Wicked Worm Beast
cards.officialText: Once per turn, during your End Phase: Return this face-up card to the hand.

implementationNotes: The End Phase return is planned only while the card remains face-up in a Monster Zone and the current team turn matches the current controller's team.
Physical owner and controller are independent. The return destination is always the physical owner's hand, even after control changes.
A per-turn UID ledger makes repeated resolver calls idempotent. The helper returns a movement plan and does not mutate DuelState.
scope: Isolated behavior primitive, tests, official evidence and focused workflow only. No effect registry, catalog, certification, Discord handler or persistence integration.
certificationGate: Do not certify until registered in the production resolver and exercised through a complete 2v2 End Phase/Discord handler flow.
